skill_name: Describe the atmosphere at a summer evening barbecue
workflow: A summer evening barbecue is a perfect time for friends and family to come together, relax and enjoy a meal. The atmosphere is relaxed and jovial, with people chatting, laughing and sharing stories. The smell of freshly grilled food drifts through the air and fills the area with a refreshing scent. Music is playing softly and the hustle and bustle of the bustling city streets can be heard in the background. The stars are twinkling above and the world seems just a bit magical.
